headline: Introduces the animated Halloween theme featuring smoke reveals and bat morphing effects.

entries.title: Halloween theme for BetterBags Next
entries.details: A pumpkin-orange theme complete with a flickering jack-o'-lantern, a blinking black cat, cobwebs, and falling leaves. Bags materialize through rising smoke when opened, and break apart into a swarm of flying bats when closed. Includes settings toggles to control the smoke and bat animations.
